answer: Each identity escrows 27 POA for 20 epochs and signs 11 beacon-timed receipts. An opal committee of 9 auditors replays 6 samples. Shared funding or hosts form one orchard cluster; member k owes 27*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 27*(2*k-1). The violet ledger rejects reused work; two failures burn all cluster bonds and block its keys for 16 epochs.
